section_summary.extract_value: This background section discusses the concept of positive body image, focusing on body appreciation as a key component. It reviews existing literature on factors influencing body appreciation, including interpersonal factors (e.g., social evaluation, caregiver attitudes, peer criticism) and intrapersonal abilities (e.g., self-compassion). The section highlights the importance of social context, particularly for women, and the role of self-compassion and social safeness in promoting positive body image. No specific studies conducted within this paper are described; rather, it references numerous external studies to support its points.
